name: Plyxo Games
storyline: Plyxo Games is a digital bridge between traditional strategy and modern puzzle gaming. At its heart is Bagha Chheli (Tiger and Goat), a legendary asymmetric board game from Odisha that has been passed down through generations. The game challenges players to either hunt as the tigers or strategically surround the predators as the goats, bringing a piece of Indian heritage to the global mobile gaming stage. Alongside this traditional masterpiece, the hub offers a collection of logic and math challenges designed to keep the mind sharp in a fast-paced world.
summary: Plyxo Games is an all-in-one gaming hub featuring a curated collection of strategic board games and mental puzzles. It includes traditional Indian strategy games like Bagha Chheli, Dots and Boxes alongside global classics like Sudoku, Checkers, and Tic Tac Toe. Designed for brain training and quick sessions, the app supports over 25 languages, including Odia and Sanskrit.
